title: The Distant Signal
author: Felix Vane
blurb: Astrid Quintana, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
